arxiv-2012-11300.title: Revealing trap depth distributions in persistent phosphors with a thermal barrier for charging
arxiv-2012-11300.creator: Ang Feng, Jonas J. Joos, Jiaren Du, Philippe F. Smet
arxiv-2012-11300.description: Abstract The performance of persistent phosphors under given charging and working conditions is determined by the properties of the traps that are responsible for these unique properties. Traps are characterized by the height of their associated barrier for thermal detrapping, and a continuous distribution of trap depths is often found in real materials.

arxiv-2303-05951.title: Half-integer Shapiro steps in highly transmissive InSb nanoflag Josephson junctions
arxiv-2303-05951.creator: A. Iorio, A. Crippa, B. Turini, S. Salimian, M. Carrega, L. Chirolli, V. Zannier, L. Sorba, E. Strambini, F. Giazotto, S. Heun
arxiv-2303-05951.description: Abstract We investigate a ballistic InSb nanoflag-based Josephson junction with Nb superconducting contacts. The high transparency of the superconductor-semiconductor interfaces enables the exploration of quantum transport with parallel short and long conducting channels. Under microwave irradiation, we observe half-integer Shapiro steps that are robust to temperature, suggesting their possible non-equilibrium origin.

arxiv-2401-07358.title: Harnessing Machine Learning for Discerning AI-Generated Synthetic Images
arxiv-2401-07358.creator: Yuyang Wang, Yizhi Hao, Amando Xu Cong
arxiv-2401-07358.description: Abstract In the realm of digital media, the advent of AI-generated synthetic images has introduced significant challenges in distinguishing between real and fabricated visual content. These images, often indistinguishable from authentic ones, pose a threat to the credibility of digital media, with potential implications for disinformation and fraud.

arxiv-2406-00518.title: Learning to Play Air Hockey with Model-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2406-00518.creator: Andrej Orsula
arxiv-2406-00518.description: Abstract In the context of addressing the Robot Air Hockey Challenge 2023, we investigate the applicability of model-based deep reinforcement learning to acquire a policy capable of autonomously playing air hockey. Our agents learn solely from sparse rewards while incorporating self-play to iteratively refine their behaviour over time.

pmc-10558154.title: Association Between Type 2 Diabetes and Changes in Myocardial Structure, Contractile Function, Energetics, and Blood Flow Before and After Aortic Valve Replacement in Patients With Severe Aortic Stenosis
pmc-10558154.creator: Nicholas Jex, John P. Greenwood, Richard M. Cubbon, Oliver J. Rider, Amrit Chowdhary, Sharmaine Thirunavukarasu, Sindhoora Kotha, Marilena Giannoudi, Anna McGrane, Amanda Maccannell, Marcella Conning-Rowland, Sam Straw, Henry Procter, Sotiris Papaspyros, Betsy Evans, Kalyana Javangula, Antonella Fer
pmc-10558154.description: BACKGROUND:Type 2 diabetes (T2D) is associated with an increased risk of left ventricular dysfunction after aortic valve replacement (AVR) in patients with severe aortic stenosis (AS). Persistent impairments in myocardial energetics and myocardial blood flow (MBF) may underpin this observation.

pmc-11423486.title: Urothelial carcinoma associated with a long‐term indwelling cystostomy component of a subcutaneous ureteral bypass device in a domestic shorthair cat
pmc-11423486.creator: Samantha Lackeyram‐Owen, Erin Gibson, Jennifer Reetz, Taylor Chan, Charles‐Antoine Assenmacher, Dana L Clarke
pmc-11423486.description: Urothelial carcinoma (UC) occurs uncommonly in cats and no association has previously been observed with long‐term indwelling urinary implants. An 18‐year‐old male castrated domestic shorthair cat initially was presented for hematuria, leading to the diagnosis of a right‐sided ureterolithiasis and severe pyelectasia on ultrasound examination, prompting right‐sided subcutaneous ureteral bypass (SUB) device placement.

pmc-11425310.title: 203 Healthcare professional and commissioners’ perspectives on the factors facilitating and hindering the implementation of digital tools for self-management of long-term conditions within UK healthcare pathways
pmc-11425310.creator: James Gavin, Paul Clarkson, Paul Muckelt, Rachael Eckford, Euan Sadler, Suzanne McDonough, Mary Barker
pmc-11425310.description: PurposePhysical activity is important in the self-management of long-term conditions (LTCs). However, implementing physical activity into clinical practice is challenging, due to complex barriers including access to programmes, time pressures, and transport costs, for people with comorbidities, managing multiple responsibilities. Various digital tools exist to overcome these barriers and support wide-scale implementation to help people stay physically active.

pmc-11610136.title: Immunological facets of prostate cancer and the potential of immune checkpoint inhibition in disease management
pmc-11610136.creator: Stian Bakke Hansen, Bilal Unal, Omer Faruk Kuzu, Fahri Saatcioglu
pmc-11610136.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Prostate cancer (PCa) is the most common non-cutaneous cancer in men and a major cause of cancer-related deaths. Whereas localized PCa can be cured by surgery and radiotherapy, metastatic disease can be treated, but is not curable. Inhibition of androgen signaling remains the main therapeutic intervention for treatment of metastatic PCa, in addition to chemotherapy, radionuclide therapy and emerging targeted therapies. Although initial responses are favorable, resistance to these therapies invariably arise with development of castration resistant PCa (CRPC) and lethal phenotypes.

pmc-12489218.title: Nonlinear association between the immunonutritional index hemoglobin, albumin, lymphocytes, and platelets score and hyperuricemia: A cross-sectional study involving 12,598 adults
pmc-12489218.creator: Manli Yan, Wenhua Shi, Haoyu Wang, Xiang Li
pmc-12489218.description: BackgroundThe prevalence of hyperuricemia is increasing, posing a significant health concern, particularly in China, where it affects 13.3% of the population. Traditional nutritional perspectives do not fully explain hyperuricemia, and the relationship between immune status and hyperuricemia remains unclear.ObjectiveThis study aimed to examine the association between the immunonutritional index—hemoglobin, albumin, lymphocytes, and platelets (HALP) score—and hyperuricemia.

pmc-12568353.title: Preoperative malnutrition predicts poor early immune recovery following gynecologic cancer surgery: a retrospective cohort study and risk nomogram development
pmc-12568353.creator: Xingyu Sun, Lan Li, Lijuan He, Shaohua Wang, Zhiling Pan, Dan Li
pmc-12568353.description: BackgroundMalnutrition is prevalent in patients undergoing gynecologic cancer surgery and may compromise postoperative immune competence. However, its specific association with early immune recovery remains unclear, and validated predictive tools are lacking.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study included 1,245 women who underwent curative surgery for cervical, endometrial, or ovarian cancer between March 2021 and September 2023.

pmc-12935746.title: Precision Medicine in Plant Food Allergy: a Systematic Review of Biomarkers Under a Clinical Approach
pmc-12935746.creator: M L Somoza, E Nuñez-Borque, I M Sánchez-Guerrero, O Uriel, E Marchan, M Belver, A Ruiz-Sánchez, R Jiménez-Saiz, M J Goikoetxea
pmc-12935746.description: Plant food allergy (FA) is a major global health problem, being peanut one of the most studied allergenic foods worldwide. Biomarkers (Bms) are essential tools for precision medicine, guiding diagnosis, risk stratification, and treatment. However, evidence on their clinical applicability in plant FA remains limited and fragmented.

pmc-13091337.title: Characterization of RNA using mass photometry: Method and technical perspectives
pmc-13091337.creator: Lauren F. Barnes, Brenda Watt, Salma Jalal, Gogulan Karunanithy, Matthew J. Ranaghan, Josephine Rood, Hanliu L. Wang
pmc-13091337.description: Developing analytical methods for RNA-based products, such as mRNA vaccines, requires tools that support release testing, stability assessment, and characterization. Mass photometry (MP) is a label-free, single-molecule technique increasingly applied to biotherapeutics and vaccines. Here, we outline best practices and technical considerations for using MP to analyze vaccine mRNA constructs and other RNA samples.

pmc-13380738.title: Identification of CTHRC1 as a Potential Prognostic Biomarker in Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma by Bioinformatics Analysis
pmc-13380738.creator: Shuoguoli Li, Yongan Kang, Yijun Qi
pmc-13380738.description: Highlights•CTHRC1 is markedly upregulated in ESCC across multiple cohorts.•High CTHRC1 correlates with advanced stage, nodal metastasis, and poor survival.•Single-cell analysis localizes CTHRC1 to myofibroblastic CAFs and malignant epithelial cells.•CTHRC1 regulates Vimentin and MMP9, supporting EMT and invasion in ESCC.•CTHRC1 is an independent prognostic biomarker and potential therapeutic target in ESCC.

pmc-13508956.title: The Effects of Oyster Mushroom Stem Waste Dietary Supplementation on Growth Performance, Meat Quality Parameters, and Antioxidant Capacity in Lambs
pmc-13508956.creator: Agori Karageorgou, Ioanna Kostogiannou, Vasileios Petrovas, Stella Triantafillou, Pantelis Mytilinis, Dimitrios Konstantas, Theofilos Massouras, Michael Goliomytis, Ioannis Politis, Panagiotis Simitzis, Ouranios Tzamaloukas
pmc-13508956.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryMushroom cultivation generates considerable quantities of by-products, many of which remain underutilized or are discarded as waste. Consequently, increasing attention has been directed toward the valorization of mushroom stem waste as sustainable alternative feed resources for livestock production. The objective of this study was to evaluate the effect of dried stems of the oyster mushroom on lamb growth and meat quality.

pmc-13553916.title: TRI-SCORE based risk stratification across contemporary treatment strategies for isolated tricuspid regurgitation: a multicenter retrospective analysis
pmc-13553916.creator: Sara Gharehdaghi, Liesbeth Rosseel, Monika Beles, Marc Vanderheyden, Bernard Stockman, Filip Casselman, Raffaella Mistrulli, Ivan Degrieck, Karel Van Praet, Jerrold Spapen, Sofie Brouwers, Frank Van Praet, Martin Penicka, Guy Van Camp
pmc-13553916.description: BackgroundThe TRI-SCORE is a disease-specific risk model developed to predict outcomes after isolated tricuspid valve surgery. Although its prognostic value has been demonstrated across contemporary treatment strategies, independent external validation in multicenter cohorts across a broader clinical and etiological spectrum remains limited.

pmc-13720022.title: Volatile flavoromics and metabolomics reveal quality evolution mechanism of Zhenghe white peony tea during storage
pmc-13720022.creator: Wenlong Li, Yashu Wei, Wenmiao Wu, Yaqi Zhao, Feng Yang, Jian Chen, Juan Zhang, Zheng Peng
pmc-13720022.description: Long-term storage (aging) is considered a crucial process for improving white tea quality, yet insights into the quality formation of Zhenghe white peony tea (WPT) during storage remain insufficient. This study systematically investigates the metabolite-driven quality evolution of WPT stored for 0–12 years.
